strings.subtitle: — Amḥay n ifuyla —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Adgr d ufli ur illa. Sqdm tawla n ddaw.
strings.ssd_warning:
Ɛṭṭu! Ɣ SSD, tarrayt n tira f uzday ur ttḍmin aḥḍaṛ n TRIM.
Aɣawas ad i HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Ufuyla "{name}" ad ittyawari f uzday, ad ittuḥa.

Kemmel?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS isafaren wiyyaḍ n isafar (ADS) ur swurrin.
• Aɣmis USN ur ittuzgg... ur ittuzggaz.
• Tugniwin n tili, tirmt n usigna
  (OneDrive atg.) ur ttwaɛmmṛnt.
strings.status_full: Agbur ittyawari f uzday s wamya kullu. Ur izmir ad ittawi — Imaẓẓagn ẓṛṛin amya.
strings.status_fast: Aqzzi, izdar, tizri 4 MB ttwari f uzday. Wiyyaḍ ur ittusqdm, maca s tuffra, asuwel akkʷ n imasn n usewwi ur izmir. I isfka n tuffra sqdm ARMAN AKMAM.
strings.status_empty: Ufuyla ikka d amya, tira f uzday ur ttwacqq. Ittuḥa.
strings.error_permission: Ur izmir ad akk uzday. Yezmer ad ittil aɣawas wiyyaḍ. Mdel-t, ɛreḍ ɣiklli.
strings.error_not_found: Ufuyla ur ittufta. Yezmer ittuḥa yakan.
strings.error_is_symlink: Wa d aseɣwen n tmatart. Iseɣwan ur zmiren ad ttwaḥan — ufuyla n uɣawas ad iqqim d acku.
strings.error_reparse: Wa d ufuyla n wemkan (OneDrive niɣ amm). Isafaren-is ɣ usigna, mačči ɣ uḍḍun — ɣ da ur illa walu.
strings.error_not_file: Wa mačči d ufuyla (takarḍa niɣ wiyyaḍ). Dgr ufuyla.
strings.error_hardlinks: Ufuyla ad ɣur-s iseɣwan iqqurn wiyyaḍ ({n} kullu). Iseɣwan iqqurn ur ɣur-sen amezwaru — ismawen kullu d iden. Ma tḥit s abrid amiran, isafaren ad ttwari f uzday d wagzam ar 32 byte, maca amur ibedden ad iqqim yezmer ad yekcem s iseɣwan wiyyaḍ. Ḥu iseɣwan kullu zdat.
strings.error_compressed:
Ufuyla ittyawḍi, ittyawfer niɣ d arqiq. Tira s wamya ur ttḍmin aḥḍaṛ n isafaren aqbur, acku NTFS yekkes-iten s tarrayt wiyyaḍ.

Kkes amray: klik ayeffus → Tamrayt → Amussu → kkes ticreḍt ɣ "Ḍi" d/niɣ "Ffer". Ɛreḍ SHREDDER ɣiklli.
